approved.en: Russian strikes killed seven civilians in Ukraine after a US envoy met Putin, while Russian drones hit targets in Moscow-area airports and a semiconductor plant in Oryol. Melania Trump brokered a ceasefire in a Russian-occupied Ukrainian town and a local ceasefire was agreed in Oleshky, reducing fighting in those areas. Ukraine reported Starlink speed curbs persisting despite promises, and Russian-linked hackers used a decentralised network for cyberattacks on Ukrainian data centres. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Israeli forces have intensified operations in the occupied West Bank, demolishing Palestinian buildings in Hebron after two Israeli soldiers were shot dead and launching a sweeping lockdown following a Hebron gunfight that left two soldiers and two gunmen dead. Simultaneously, an Israeli airstrike hit a building in Nuseirat, Gaza, captured on video, while Israeli attacks on West Bank olive farmers have escalated, killing several farmers. Prime Minister Netanyahu has announced an extensive military operation and closure of the West Bank in response to the Hebron attack. The conflict produced 21,440 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Samtidig traff et israelsk luftangrep en bygning i Nuseirat i Gaza, og dette ble filmet, mens israelske angrep på olivenbønder på Vestbredden har eskalert og drept flere bønder. Statsminister Netanyahu har kunngjort en omfattende militæroperasjon og stenging av Vestbredden som svar på angrepet i Hebron. Konflikten førte til 21 440 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Hezbollah explosives seized from two Lebanese trucks have led Lebanon's prime minister and security forces to promise a thorough investigation while Israeli artillery and air strikes continue against Hezbollah positions in southern Lebanon, causing civilian casualties. In northern Israel a Hezbollah submunition exploded in a teenager's backpack, killing Elazar Yair Wilensky and wounding dozens, prompting an IDF probe and possible hike restrictions. Qatar has pledged funding for reconstruction in southern Lebanon, announced a massive solar plant project, and its foreign minister called for Israeli withdrawal from Lebanon. The UCDP recorded 4,335 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Nord-Israel eksploderte en Hezbollah-submunisjon i en tenårings ryggsekk, og drepte Elazar Yair Wilensky og såret dusinvis, noe som har ført til en IDF-undersøkelse og mulige restriksjoner på høyde. Qatar har lovet finansiering til gjenoppbygging i Sør-Libanon, kunngjort et massivt solkraftprosjekt, og utenriksministeren oppfordret til israelsk tilbaketrekning fra Libanon. approved.en: Iran has warned it will strike oil and AI facilities across the Gulf if attacks resume and says seven ships were hit in the Hormuz Strait, while it also detailed plans to hit Gulf undersea cables if war resumes. Missiles struck King Fahd airport in Saudi Arabia, killing one person and wounding eight, prompting the United States to order personnel to leave Saudi Arabia and advise diplomats to depart. Lavrov visited Tehran and publicly backed Iran, hinting at possible Russian involvement, as the United States and Israel draft plans for renewed strikes after the US midterm elections. Saudi Arabia is expanding a missile plant that may produce more powerful missiles, and oil prices rose above $117 a barrel amid fears of renewed US strikes on Iran. 123 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Iran har advart om at de vil angripe olje- og AI-anlegg i hele Gulf hvis angrepene gjenopptas, og sier at syv skip ble truffet i Hormuzstredet, samtidig som de også detaljert planene om å treffe Gulf-undervannskabler hvis krigen gjenopptas. Missiler traff King Fahd-flyplassen i Saudi-Arabia, drepte én person og såret åtte, noe som førte til at USA beordret personell til å forlate Saudi-Arabia og rådet diplomater om å dra. Lavrov besøkte Teheran og støttet offentlig Iran, og antydet mulig russisk involvering, mens USA og Israel utarbeider planer for nye angrep etter USAs mellomvalgsvalg. Saudi-Arabia utvider et missilverk som kan produsere kraftigere missiler, og oljeprisene steg over 117 dollar per fat på grunn av frykt for nye amerikanske angrep på Iran. 123 kamprelaterte dødsfall skjedde i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Houthi forces have intensified missile and drone attacks on Saudi Arabia, striking Riyadh, Khamis Mushait and Dammam airport, where a missile killed two people and injured eight. The Saudi-led coalition continues to intercept these weapons, downing missiles over Saudi territory and repelling overnight attack waves on Saudi targets. Yemeni forces reported over a thousand strikes on Houthi positions in a single day, showing heightened counter-offensive activity. The conflict caused 918 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Den Saudi-ledede koalisjonen fortsetter å avskjære disse våpnene, skyter ned missiler over Saudi-territorium og avviser nattlige angrepsbølger mot Saudi-mål. Jemen-styrkene rapporterte over tusen angrep på houthi-posisjoner på én dag, noe som viser økt motoffensiv aktivitet. Konflikten forårsaket 918 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Israeli forces fired across the border into southern Syria, killing a Syrian man with disabilities in the Daraa buffer zone and deploying rooftop snipers who opened fire in the south. Syrian security officers were killed in a raid on an ISIL cell near Damascus. Hundreds of Syrians protested repeated Israeli incursions, while Syrian Christians faced heightened risk of killing or abduction. Jordanian and Syrian foreign ministers held expanded talks in Aqaba, and a US envoy noted that Syria's interim leader seeks Israel normalization. The war caused 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Syriske sikkerhetsoffiserer ble drept i et raid på en IS-celle nær Damaskus. Hundrevis av syrere protesterte mot gjentatte israelske inntrengninger, mens syriske kristne stod overfor økt risiko for drap eller bortføring. Jordanske og syriske utenriksministre holdt utvidede samtaler i Akaba, og en amerikansk sendebud bemerket at Syriens midlertidige leder søker normalisering med Israel. Krigen forårsaket 2 732 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Sudanese armed forces have carried out drone strikes on markets in the disputed Abyei border region, killing more than 150 people in each attack. The strikes hit civilian gatherings, including mourners and a fuel market, causing hundreds of casualties. Communal clashes continue, with killings reported between Warrap and Lakes communities and arrests related to youth violence in Juba. Fresh attacks in Ruweng left nine dead and six wounded, and bodies arrived from the Khor Kaltan killings in Northern Bahr el Ghazal. The UCDP recorded two battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Den sudanske hæren har gjennomført droneangrep på markeder i den omstridte grenseområdet Abyei, og drept mer enn 150 personer i hvert angrep. Angrepene rammet sivile samlinger, inkludert sørgende og et drivstoffmarked, og forårsaket hundrevis av skadde. Kommunale sammenstøt fortsetter, med drap rapportert mellom Warrap- og Lakes-samfunnene og arrestasjoner knyttet til ungdomsvold i Juba. Nye angrep i Ruweng etterlot ni døde og seks sårede, og lik ankom fra drapene i Khor Kaltan i Nord-Bahr el Ghazal. UCDP registrerte to dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Ethiopian forces have installed a caretaker administration in Tigray and are advancing toward the Eritrean border, while a pro-government militia says it seized the regional airport and reports Eritrean forces suffered losses there. The United States, through Secretary of State Marco Rubio, is urging Ethiopia and Eritrea to de-escalate, and Mekelle mayor Shishay Amare announced elections within six months to settle Western Tigray through constitutional processes. A drone strike in the disputed Abyei region killed at least 73 people, and the TPLF claims to have killed 1,511 Ethiopian soldiers in recent fighting. The conflict caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Etiopiske styrker har installert en midlertidig administrasjon i Tigray og rykker frem mot den eritreiske grensen, mens en pro-regjeringsmilits hevder at den har tatt kontroll over den regionale flyplassen og rapporterer at eritreiske styrker led tap der. USA, gjennom utenriksminister Marco Rubio, oppfordrer Etiopia og Eritrea til å dempe konflikten, og Mekelle borgermester Shishay Amare kunngjorde valg innen seks måneder for å løse Vest-Tigray gjennom konstitusjonelle prosesser. Et droneangrep i det omstridte Abyei-området drepte minst 73 personer, og TPLF hevder å ha drept 1 511 etiopiske soldater i nylige kamper. Konflikten forårsaket 2 824 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Fitgharan forces now control the Mogadishu-Baidoa corridor while Laftagareen forces have seized Buurhakaba and another town in the Bay region, expanding fighting in southern Somalia. Al Shabaab detonated an IED in Mandera, injuring six civilians, and the ICRC treated 148 wounded after heavy combat in Baidoa. Ethiopia has withdrawn more than 3,000 troops and will not intervene in the South West State conflict, while the UAE drone strike in Puntland killed four family members, including a pregnant teenager, and the US and UAE carried out airstrikes against al-Shabaab in northern Somalia. 2,284 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Al Shabaab detonerte en IED i Mandera, og seks sivile ble såret, og Røde Kors behandlede 148 sårede etter tung kamp i Baidoa. Etiopia har trukket tilbake mer enn 3 000 soldater og vil ikke gripe inn i konflikten i South West State, mens et droneangrep fra De forente arabiske emirater i Puntland drepte fire familiemedlemmer, inkludert en gravid tenåring, og USA og De forente arabiske emirater gjennomførte luftangrep mot al Shabaab i Nord-Somalia. 2 284 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

In northern Niger, gunmen attacked buses, killing at least 12 people, and two European hostages were freed after months of captivity. In Mali, an Islamic State-affiliated group killed 48 people in an attack, and separate gunmen attacks killed over 40 civilians. The conflict produced 4,159 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

I nordlige Niger angrep bevæpnede menn busser og drepte minst 12 personer, og to europeiske gisler ble løslatt etter måneder i fangenskap. I Mali drepte en gruppe tilknyttet IS 48 personer i et angrep, og separate angrep fra bevæpnede menn drepte over 40 sivile. Konflikten førte til 4 159 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

In Benue, suspected herders killed three civilians and Senate leaders are demanding a security overhaul and troop deployment after 113 people were killed, and electricity workers withdrew services in Makurdi following an alleged attack. Bandits killed a NDC supporter in Enugu and continue to hold a widow, her son and a newborn captive three weeks after a kidnapping in Kaduna. Banditter drepte en NDC-støttespiller i Enugu og holder fortsatt en enke, hennes sønn og en nyfødt som fange tre uker etter en kidnapping i Kaduna. Flom drepte 245 personer og fordrev over 200 000, ifølge NEMA. Konflikten førte til 1 486 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: The United States has renewed a rarely used torture indictment against Maduro for ordering torture of rivals and has deployed Space Force electromagnetic and electronic warfare systems against Venezuela while pressuring Reliance to refine Venezuelan oil. Opposition groups are staging nationwide protests demanding elections and the return of Machado, and a Dutch security report warns that Venezuela’s instability could threaten Curaçao and the wider Caribbean Kingdom. The Pentagon has issued a directive banning DoD personnel from using nonpublic information to bet on U.S. military operations, including those involving Venezuela. 2 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2007, according to UCDP.
